Corporate professionals (no CXO title).open_with: This sits alongside your current job — about 15 to 20 board meetings a year, mostly online. Boards need people who know how the work actually gets done.
Corporate professionals (no CXO title).story: Nilesh D Shah: Chemical engineer, 38 plus years in operations and governance; first appointment at Baroda Extrusion.

Senior women professionals.open_with: The top 1000 listed companies must have a woman director, and several of the largest still don't have one.
Senior women professionals.story: Suman Choudhary: Agri-business consultant, 20 plus years; appointed at ZappFresh within 3 months, with zero IICA databank searches.

Business owners / promoters / consultant.open_with: Promoters prefer directors from their side of the table — you already know growing companies in your network.
Business owners / promoters / consultant.story: Ullas Pradhan: Business owner, BCom from Cuttack; cleared the exam, built LinkedIn, first appointment at 66 at Aesthetic Engineers, then Vdeal System.

Defence veterans / government / PSU.open_with: Your years of institutional responsibility are exactly what boards want; a large share of CPSE board positions are vacant.
Defence veterans / government / PSU.story: Sanjay Roye: 36 years in the Indian Navy; now an independent director at Sachee Rome Limited.

Retired professionals.open_with: After so many years of leading, what would you like your experience to do for you now — some income, staying engaged, or recognition?
Retired professionals.story: Golock Chandra Sahoo: Retired Senior Audit Officer; appointed at Ganesh Infra, then Ravita Engineering Services.

Educators - retired.open_with: Teachers and principals carry credibility boards respect — and former students now run businesses.
Educators - retired.story: Dr N Ganga Vidya: Management professor with 25 years in ESG consulting; appointed at Solar91.

Educators - working.open_with: This sits alongside teaching — books, guest lectures and TEDx build board credibility faster for educators than anyone.
Educators - working.story: Manisha Deep: Runs a coaching centre and distributorship in Ranchi; cleared the exam in 3 months, published a book and got a TEDx invite.

Engineers / construction.open_with: Boards of engineering and construction companies need someone who can read a project, a plant and a safety risk — that is your daily work.
Engineers / construction.story: M.K. Sateesh: 40 plus years in construction; started on LinkedIn and guest lectures, first appointment in 10 months at Kirtiman Agro, more after that, at 63.

Agri / food professionals.open_with: Agri and food companies are growing fast and listing on SME platforms — they need directors who understand their sector, not generic names.
Agri / food professionals.story: Suman Choudhary: Agri-business consultant, 20 plus years; appointed at ZappFresh within 3 months, with zero IICA databank searches.

Retired bankers.open_with: Boards want someone who can read credit, cash flow and risk — a banker's whole career, now on the other side of the table.
Retired bankers.story: Golock Chandra Sahoo: Retired Senior Audit Officer; appointed at Ganesh Infra, then Ravita Engineering Services.

Retired women professionals.open_with: The top 1000 listed companies must have a woman director, and your years of experience are exactly what a board looks for.
Retired women professionals.story: Suman Choudhary: Agri-business consultant, 20 plus years; appointed at ZappFresh within 3 months, with zero IICA databank searches.

CXOs / corporate leaders.open_with: You have already sat at the table where decisions are made — an independent directorship is the same judgement, across several companies, without the daily operations.
CXOs / corporate leaders.story: Nilesh D Shah: Chemical engineer, 38 plus years in operations and governance; first appointment at Baroda Extrusion.

CFOs / finance heads.open_with: Every board needs an audit committee, and the audit committee needs someone who can truly read the numbers — that is your role.
CFOs / finance heads.story: Golock Chandra Sahoo: Retired Senior Audit Officer; appointed at Ganesh Infra, then Ravita Engineering Services.

IT leaders.open_with: Boards now worry about technology, data and cyber risk, and very few directors can question it properly — that is the gap you fill.
IT leaders.story: Yakub Bhetasiwala: 21 years in industrial automation; cleared the exam, struggled for months, then built brand and network and was appointed at CORE Energy Systems.

Practising CA / CS.open_with: Your clients already trust you with their compliance — promoters prefer directors from their own side of the table, and you know growing companies in your network.
Practising CA / CS.story: Ullas Pradhan: Business owner, BCom from Cuttack; cleared the exam, built LinkedIn, first appointment at 66 at Aesthetic Engineers, then Vdeal System.

Retiring soon.open_with: The best time to build board credibility is before retirement, while your title and network are active — the first appointment often takes months.
Retiring soon.story: Golock Chandra Sahoo: Retired Senior Audit Officer; appointed at Ganesh Infra, then Ravita Engineering Services.

General.open_with: Any professional with 10 plus years in a business field qualifies; most first appointments come at SME boards.
General.story: M.K. Sateesh: 40 plus years in construction; started on LinkedIn and guest lectures, first appointment in 10 months at Kirtiman Agro, more after that, at 63.
